'''Chorh-dha''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] member of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a member of the [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]].

Chorh-dha belonged both to [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Clezo]]'s and Vigo [[Green]]'s organizations; in reality he spied on Green and reported his activities to Clezo.<ref name="sb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Clezo expected [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red's]]'s [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], and putting Chorh-da in his place as the clan's [[Chief Protector]], operating as Black Sun's puppet; this would bring more control on their homeworld for their organization.<ref name="sb" />
